يعتديان (form VIII)
# يَعْتَدِيَانِ (yaʕtadiyāni) /jaʕ.ta.di.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# يُعْتَدَيَانِ (yuʕtadayāni) /juʕ.ta.da.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
